# Proposals for curator discussion — 26 September 2026

Status: draft proposals, not adopted forum policy or minutes of the meeting. This is a public repository document, not a confidential workspace. No additional site-navigation sections, permissions, notification rules, or deployment settings have been activated.

## Encoding cases: a small pilot, not a new standard

Consider one public, permission-cleared case first. Suggested fields: case ID; project; contributor; source locator and evidence; scholarly problem; explicit source statement versus editorial inference; encoding options; chosen approach (if any); rationale and trade-offs; TEI/schema version; validation result; responsible annotator and review date; unresolved questions. Do not equate textual illegibility, a historical author's uncertainty, and an annotator's uncertainty. Record them separately where relevant.

A valid XML example is not automatically a scholarly sound interpretation. No unpublished dissertation example should be added without its author's approval.

## Sessions

A possible record can contain: title; presenter; confirmed date and timezone (only after confirmation); problem; preparation; permission-cleared materials; discussion summary; decisions actually made; dissent or unresolved questions; next action. An introductory session, a small number of work-in-progress sessions and a later synthesis can be supported without publishing dates or claiming decisions in advance. Do not reproduce private meeting links or recordings.

## Pattern library

Defer until several real cases establish recurring needs. Preserve alternative approaches and context. Avoid presenting a local preference as a universal TEI rule. No empty public Pattern Library page is introduced by this branch.

## Branding and scope

Keep the current visible forum heading until curators agree on a canonical English/Arabic name. The correction from Textual Encoding Initiative to Text Encoding Initiative fixes the expansion of TEI, not the forum's branding. Confirm how explicitly to enumerate Urdu and other Arabic-script languages; the current wording uses primarily and is not an exhaustive exclusion list. Agree on any favicon/social image before adding a new visual identity.

## Membership and public contacts

Curators should verify the intended public directory and permission to display contacts. This branch does not remove or restore members, alter contact addresses, or establish that historical consent was obtained. Keep consent records outside the public repository.

## Collaboration and repository presentation

Branch protection is an optional team decision, not a correction to a demonstrated security incident. Preserve ease of contribution through the browser. Possible lightweight approach: branches and review for multi-page/substantive edits; decide any exceptions and required approvals as a group. Do not make a new automated check mandatory before it exists and is tested.

Proposed repository homepage: https://tei-arabic.github.io/
Possible topics: tei, xml, arabic-script, digital-humanities, digital-editions, persian, ottoman-turkish.
These are proposals only: repository settings have not been changed.

## Review order

1. Review the content/accessibility commit separately from these templates.
2. Check public font loading, external links, deployment behavior and screen-reader use in a connected browser.
3. Agree on contribution guidance and public-contact handling.
4. Consider one case/session pilot, then reassess whether new navigation is warranted.
